body:
It seems to be a Flatpak issue, because running the native package works fine.

I never understood how I'm supposed to properly get the Godot flatpak to use the Android and Java SDKs on Arch, given the sandboxing and stuff. Every solution I've done before has felt kinda hackish, and maybe what I had before just broke because it's not how I'm supposed to do it. Is there a proper way I'm supposed to do it? What should the `Android SDK Path`, `Debug Keystore`, and `Java SDK Path` be set to? Am I supposed to use the system packages and give the Godot flatpak access to the paths? Which packages am I supposed to use? On the docs, it says "If you are using Linux, do not use an Android SDK provided by your distribution's repositories as it will often be outdated.", does this apply to Arch Linux even though it's rolling release? Also, am I supposed to give the Godot flatpak access to the file paths? Or am I supposed to select the paths through the file picker portal? Or is there an internal flatpak version of the library it's supposed to access?
It's all so confusing...
